name: Hasumi Ren
source:
Ren is so smart she’s almost a savant. Because she looks down on everyone else, she has no friends. She was responsible for eliminating the last teacher on charges of sexual harassment.

[From [url=http://www.erogereview.com/2009/04/21/virgin-roster/]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
